The `for item in local:` loop references `local` before assignment. I replaced the sort block with `for item in local: heapq.heappush(localh, item)` but `local` was reassigned to [] right after. Let me fix: the items are already in `localh` from the initial collection, so I should just heapify `localh`.

Let me patch properly.

arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp/tests && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='ref2.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """        for item in local:
            heapq.heappush(localh, item)
        local = []
        while True:"""
new = """        heapq.heapify(localh)
        while True:"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
PYEOF
